purpose: Strictly pre-registered, single-shot historical replication battery on UNSEEN pre-2016 data (1997-2015) plus exogenous US Debt Ceiling TGA natural experiments. Written, committed, and OpenTimestamps-anchored BEFORE pulling pre-2016 FRED/equity data. Zero post-hoc threshold tuning; all 5 outcomes reported verbatim regardless of sign or significance.

multiple_testing_policy.uncertainty_reporting: Point estimate + 95% HAC or block-bootstrap CI + raw p + Holm p

unseen_replication_window.zero_overlap_with_2016_2026_discovery_sa: Strictly enforced on REP_1..REP_4 (REP_5 explicitly includes the 2023 statutory debt ceiling episode alongside 2011, 2013, 2015).

pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.hypothesis: Monthly % change in FINRA Margin Debt is positively correlated (Pearson r > 0) with monthly S&P 500 (^GSPC) return.
pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.estimator: Pearson r with 10,000 circular-shift surrogate p-value and 6-month moving-block bootstrap 95% CI.

pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.hypothesis: Cumulative 3-week % change in Retail MMF (WRMFNS, weeks t..t+2) increases in response to equity crash weeks (^GSPC weekly return <= -2.0%) after controlling for DTB3 yield level, delta-DTB3, lagged %dWRMFNS_{t-1}, and Year Fixed Effects.
pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.estimator: OLS with Newey-West HAC standard errors (lag=4); two-sided p-value on 1(GSPC_ret_t <= -2.0%).

pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.hypothesis: Cumulative 3-week % change in Commercial Bank Deposits (Fed H.8 DPSACBW027SBOG, weeks t..t+2) increases in response to equity crash weeks (^GSPC <= -2.0%) after controlling for DTB3 yield level, delta-DTB3, lagged %dDeposits_{t-1}, and Year Fixed Effects.
pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.estimator: OLS with Newey-West HAC standard errors (lag=4); two-sided p-value on 1(GSPC_ret_t <= -2.0%).

pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.hypothesis: During unseen pre-2016 crash weeks (^GSPC <= -2.0%), the AUM-normalized flight-to-safety exact flow spread ((BIL_flow/BIL_AUM) - (JNK_flow/JNK_AUM)) is higher than in non-crash weeks.
pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.estimator: Two-group mean difference with 10,000-permutation two-sided p-value and 95% bootstrap CI (individual BIL and JNK components also reported transparently).

pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.window: Exogenous statutory US Debt Ceiling windows: 2011, 2013, 2015, 2023
pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.hypothesis: During exogenous post-suspension TGA rebuild weeks (draining reserves) vs exogenous impasse TGA drawdown weeks (injecting reserves), weekly % change in Commercial Bank Deposits (DPSACBW027SBOG) is lower (negative mean difference).
pre_registered_hypotheses_M5.estimator: Two-group mean difference (Rebuild - Drawdown) with 10,000-permutation two-sided p-value and 95% bootstrap CI; WRMFNS and ^GSPC reported alongside as secondary diagnostics.
